== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-wedgeantilles-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Wedge Antilles]] (Decipher; Decipher's [[Wedge Antilles (Decipher Errata 1998)|November 1998 errata]] was published as text only): The game text changes: “any starship” becomes “anything”; “On” becomes “When piloting”; “search your Reserve Deck and” is dropped; “hand. Shuffle, cut and replace.” becomes “hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”. These are the same words as [[Wedge Antilles (Decipher Errata 1998)|Decipher's errata]]. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “•Wedge Antilles” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
